question: MTS120mS3-N (SRR31123507) has 24,440 reads (study median 6,925,974). Set include = FALSE. Agree?
proposed_answer: Exclude; shoot +N at 120 min keeps 2 replicates.

question: Root -N 120 min has 4 libraries (MTS120mR1-4-noN) while the design states 3 per time point per treatment. Keep the 4th?
proposed_answer: Keep as replicate 4 (separate GSM8594908 / BioSample); nothing suggests a duplicate.
evidence: GEO GSE280345; paper Methods: three biological replicates per time point per treatment

question: Time 0 has one set of 3 libraries per tissue (treatment noN), shared by +N and -N series. Coded phase starvation, time_h 0, N 0. Use as the common baseline for both arms?
proposed_answer: Yes; per-time-point +N vs -N contrasts are the primary comparison, T0 is the shared baseline.
evidence: GEO treatment 'noN' for MTS0mS1-3 and MTS0mR1-3-noN; paper: harvested at 0, 5, ... 120 min

question: All 115 libraries are Lexogen QuantSeq 3' mRNA-seq with UMIs (one read per transcript 3' end); needs a 3'-aware quantification (UMI dedup, no length normalisation). Flag for processing?
proposed_answer: Process with UMI-tools dedup + gene-level counts; treat effect sizes as comparable to full-length RNA-seq log2FC.
